figures.name: Mari

ability.name: Storm of Anboto
ability.description: Deal 5 storm damage to all enemies; cleanse all debuffs from all allies.

figures.description: Supreme Basque goddess who lives in the mountain caves and manifests as storm, fire, tree or woman.

figures.name: Sugaar

ability.name: Serpent Tempest
ability.description: Transform into a serpent: deal 4 damage to all enemies and inflict poison for 2 turns.

figures.description: Serpentine storm god and consort of Mari who rises from underground to mate with her and birth the storms.

figures.name: Basajaun

ability.name: Forest Sentinel
ability.description: Grant all allies +3 defense; warn of danger — enemy ambush abilities fail once.

figures.description: Wild lord of the forest who taught humans agriculture and ironwork and protects flocks from wolves.

figures.name: Urtzi

ability.name: Sky Vault
ability.description: Grant all allies immunity to air and storm attacks for 2 turns.

figures.description: Ancient sky father of the Basques, largely replaced by Mari, but still remembered as the original sky.

figures.name: Herensuge

ability.name: Sevenfold Flame
ability.description: Attack seven times dealing 1 damage each; each attack ignores a different defensive ability.

figures.description: Seven-headed dragon from Basque legend that terrorizes the land and requires human sacrifice to be appeased.

figures.name: Gaueko

ability.name: Night Shroud
ability.description: Reduce all enemies' power by 2 during the night phase; immune to light damage.

figures.description: Personification of the night who commands that those born of the day should return home at dark.

figures.name: Amalur

ability.name: Deep Earth
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; nature and earth allies gain +2 defense.

figures.description: Mother Earth herself in Basque cosmology, from whose body all living things grow and to whom they return.

figures.name: Laminak

ability.name: Night Builders
ability.description: Build a defense: reduce all incoming damage by 2 for 1 turn.

figures.description: Beautiful fairy women who work ceaselessly at night constructing bridges and buildings, abandoned at dawn.

figures.name: Aker

ability.name: Subterranean Pull
ability.description: Drag one enemy underground: they miss their next turn.

figures.description: Evil spirit of the underground associated with goats who brings misfortune from below.

figures.name: Hodei

ability.name: Rain Calling
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to earth and nature allies; inflict wet status on all enemies (-1 fire res).

figures.description: Personification of the storm cloud that follows in Mari's wake, bringing life-giving rain.

figures.name: Ilargi

ability.name: Moonlit Path
ability.description: Remove all dark debuffs from one ally; grant +2 magic for 1 turn.

figures.description: Moon goddess who guides the spirits of the dead and lights the way for those who travel by night.

figures.name: Eguzki

ability.name: Sunflower Ward
ability.description: Place a ward: the next dark ability used against any ally is negated.

figures.description: Sun goddess whose image the sunflower (eguzkilore) replicates to ward off evil spirits from the home.

figures.name: Tartalo

ability.name: Cyclops Crush
ability.description: Deal 6 damage to one enemy; destroy that enemy's shield or armor ability.

figures.description: One-eyed mountain giant from Basque legend who captures and devours travelers, echoing the story of Polyphemus.

figures.name: Jentilak

ability.name: Standing Stone
ability.description: Place a stone: absorb the next 4 damage dealt to any ally.

figures.description: Race of ancient Basque giants who built the great megalithic monuments and fled before the Christian cross.

figures.name: Sorgin

ability.name: Witches' Sabbath
ability.description: Inflict confusion on one enemy for 2 turns; they have 50% chance to hit wrong target.

figures.description: Night-flying witches who serve Mari and travel to her mountain on Fridays, masters of dark charms.

figures.name: Basandere

ability.name: Wild Woman's Grace
ability.description: Ally and beast cards gain +2 speed for 2 turns.

figures.description: Companion of Basajaun, the wild woman of the forest who shares his role as guardian of the natural world.

figures.name: Olentzero

ability.name: Solstice Coal
ability.description: Deal 1 damage to dark enemies; give light allies a bonus gift: +2 to a random stat.

figures.description: Giant charcoal-maker who descends from the mountains at the winter solstice to celebrate the return of the sun.

figures.name: Intxixu

ability.name: Cave Goblin
ability.description: Steal one random item buff from an enemy and destroy it.

figures.description: Small devil-like cave spirit who causes mischief and chaos around the ancient sacred caves of the Basques.

figures.name: Anjel

ability.name: Guardian Voice
ability.description: Warn: the next attack against any ally deals 2 less damage.

figures.description: Protective spirit being who serves as intermediary between the Basque people and the higher divine powers.

figures.name: Eguzkilore

ability.name: Solar Bloom
ability.description: Negate the first dark-alignment ability used each turn against your team.

figures.description: The sunflower spirit whose dried image placed above the doorway prevents all evil spirits from entering.
